name: Nova
source:
"Yo! I'm Nova the great! Ludens aren't so rare anymore, so I'm out here being a detective. Wanna be my client? If it's about Sagami City, leave it to me! ♪"

A Luden who works as a detective in Japan. Despite her intimidating appearance and flashy lines, she's reliable and loyal to her clients, so she's earned a good reputation. She was originally asked to collect gossip for [url=/c160633]Alice[/url], but distanced herself once she realized there wasn't much in it for her. When it comes to knowledge about Sagami City, no one surpasses her.

[url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] will be saved more than once thanks to Nova's deep insight and wealth of knowledge.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category2&ch=nova]official website[/url]]
